analysis_focus: team adoption: learning curve, training burden, resistance, change management
learning_curve_salesforce: Steep: 4-8 weeks to AM fluency; requires part-time admin the agency lacks; media buyers get little native value; creatives disengage
learning_curve_hubspot: Shallow: 3-7 days to working competence, 2-3 weeks to fluency; free HubSpot Academy role-based training; agency staff often pre-exposed via client work
learning_curve_zoho: Moderate: 2-4 weeks to AM fluency; denser UI, weaker discoverability, ecosystem scope creep risk
key_resistance_points: AMs resist manual data entry; HubSpot auto-logging mitigates best
Media buyers judge CRM by ad-ops integration; all platforms need connectors
Creatives show silent non-use; keep them read-only on any platform
40-person agency cannot absorb Salesforce's 2-month productivity dip
change_management_recommendations: Two internal champions (senior AM + media buyer) with weekly office hours for 8 weeks
Phased rollout: AMs weeks 1-4, media buyers + ad-ops integration weeks 5-8, creatives read-only week 9+
Migrate only live clients and last 12 months of history
Three non-negotiable usage behaviours modelled by leadership
Adoption metrics at weeks 4/8/12; <70% AM weekly-active at week 8 triggers intervention
assumptions: Role mix estimated: ~12 account managers, ~8 media buyers, ~14 creatives, ~6 ops/leadership
Costs are 2025-era knowledge-based EUR estimates, not quotes
No incumbent CRM; assumed migration from spreadsheets/inbox
Adoption assessed independently of pricing and GDPR (covered by sibling agents)
